title: once() and safe removal in the event emitter
prompt:
Add `once(event, fn)` to the `Emitter` in src/emitter.js (the listener runs on the next emit only) and make `off`
work for listeners added with `once` (pass the original function). Removing or adding listeners while an event is
being emitted must not skip or double-call the other listeners of that emit: each emit calls exactly the listeners
that were registered when it started (minus those removed during it).
